title: ר' חנינא בן פזי

paragraphs: R. Chanina ben Pazi: Bereshit Rabbah, Lekh Lekha, section 46; Vayetze, section 70; Shemot Rabbah, end of section 40; Bemidbar Rabbah, section 3; Kedoshim, section 25, has R. Chanin. Lekh Lekha above, Tanchuma, and Rabbah, Chukkat, section 19, have R. Chanan ben Pazi; Shocher Tov, section 92. In Yalkut that matter has bar Pappi, a scribal error. Yalkut, section 12, has R. Shimon ben Pazi, likewise a scribal error; it should read R. Chanina ben Pazi. Yalkut on Psalms, section 139, has R. Yochanan ben Pazi, perhaps also a scribal error. Jerusalem Talmud, end of Keitzad Meabberin, has R. Inya bar Pazi; apparently this is R. Chanina ben Pazi. See R. Chanina bar Sisi above.
